scripted_turns: make a FigJam ER diagram of the Roamstay stays model on a new board in our Roamstay Product plan, and group the partner tables apart from the guest tables. From the schema note: guests, bookings, payments, properties, rooms and rate plans. A guest makes bookings, a booking reserves one room under one rate plan and holds its payments, and a property offers rooms and publishes rate plans. Keep the keys and the few columns support asks about. The schema note also says: a payment has an amount, a currency, a status of authorised, captured or refunded and a provider reference. A rate plan has a name, a nightly price and a cancellation rule. A booking keeps its check-in and check-out dates and its own status.
